test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If unemployment continues for long-term in a country, it is called ______ unemployment.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chronic**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chronic Unemployment:**

 
 
• Chronic unemployment refers to** long-term unemployment typically caused by structural problems in the economy.**
 
• It is not due to the usual ups and downs of the business cycle but rather persists even in good economic times.
 
• Those who suffer from **chronic unemployment lack the skills or education needed for new jobs or live in parts of the country where jobs are scarce.**
 
• This type of unemployment can lead to a vicious cycle of** joblessness, poverty, and social issues.**
 
• It requires concerted policy efforts to resolve, such as** retraining programs, education reform, and economic development initiatives.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Casual Unemployment:**

 
 
• This refers to temporary **unemployment which occurs when workers are laid off or lose their jobs due to seasonal changes in demand or supply in certain industries.**
 
 
 
• **Technological Unemployment:**
 
 
• This type of unemployment is caused by **technological changes or automation that render certain jobs obsolete.**
 
• Workers displaced by technology **need to acquire new skills to find employment in other sectors.**
 
 
 
• **Frictional Unemployment:**
 
 
• This is a type of **short-term unemployment that occurs when people are between jobs or are looking for their first job.**
 
• **It's a natural part of the job market as people move between roles and careers.**
